Class LobbyViewController

java.lang.Object
view.LobbyViewController
All Implemented Interfaces:
SceneController, ViewController
public class LobbyViewController extends Object implements SceneController
Lobby browser: refresh, create, join. Selecting a lobby and pressing Enter (or double-clicking) joins it; pushing a create-lobby command opens a small dialog for the player count.

    • onCreate

      private void onCreate()
      Called when the user clicks on the "Create New Lobby" button. Show the CreateLobbyDialog and, after the user choose the number of player of the new game, sends a create-lobby command to the server.

    • joinSelected

      private void joinSelected()
      Called after the double click on the chosen lobby or after the selection and the press of the Enter key. If the user has selected a lobby, a join-lobby command is sent to the server via SceneRouter with the id of the selected lobby. If not an error toast is shown.
